items.title: The team behind Tailwind CSS is joining Shopify
items.blurb: We're joining Shopify to give Tailwind a stable long-term home where it will be actively maintained for the millions of people who depend on it.

items.title: Here's a report on what it achieved
items.blurb: In July 2022, Ruby Central and Shopify launched Ruby Shield, a four-year partnership built around a single goal: giving the tools at the heart of the Ruby ecosystem the sustained investment they need to stay secure and reliable.
